text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
After enjoying the food he had cooked with
Nephy Nella, {0} was resting in a
room in the private home that had been rented
to him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ネフィ＝ネラと作った料理を堪能した{0}は、
貸し与えられた民家の一室で身を休めていた。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ...May I come in? My Lord Knight...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──もし？
騎士殿や……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
It seems you are awake after all. That is
fortunate.
text_block_list.orig_text:
起きては──
いらっしゃるようです喃。
是は幸い。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Though it seems you still drift between
dreams and the waking world. I beg your
pardon for intruding so often.
text_block_list.orig_text:
然れど、
夢路と現世の狭間に揺蕩うておられる御様子。
度々御無礼仕り、
恐縮至極に存じまする。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Watching your sleeping face would be a
delight in itself... yet before you retire, I
wished to exchange a few intimate words.
text_block_list.orig_text:
寝入り給うお前さまの御顔を拝するも
一興では御座いまするが。
床入りの砌に、
些とばかり
睦言を交わしたく……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
It is nothing urgent. Merely a small personal
sentiment left unresolved.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何、
火急の仕儀にはありませぬ。
私的なる思い残しなれば。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
As one who is hardly "human", I cannot say
whether such words are proper. But to speak
plainly... I carry a loneliness best
described as "dissatisfaction". And so, I
wished to deepen our closeness a little
longer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『人でなし』の身にて、
斯様な物言いが相応しきや
定かならねど。
有体に申さば……
「物足りぬ」
と云うべき寂寥を抱えておりまして喃。
今暫く、
懇意を重ねたく思い侍り。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
...From here on, enjoy yourself in the bed of
dreams. Let us sink together into that
dreamlike world... like bodies drifting upon
still water, descending into sweet depths.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……此の先は
夢の褥にて存分に。
水面の如き夢境に
身を浸し、
共に甘き深みへと
沈みましょうぞ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
One evening, {0} returned home from
school. When he opened the living room's
door, he saw...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ある日の夕刻、
学校から帰宅した{0}。
リビングの扉を開けると、
そこには──

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Tofu, long green onion, miso... I see, I see.
It appears the essentials are mostly
accounted for.
text_block_list.orig_text:
豆腐、
根深、
未醤……
成程
成程。
目ぼしき品は、
粗方事足りている様子。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
My... Forgive my rudeness. This electric
storehouse that chills and preserves food is
truly a most mysterious device. I could not
help but peer inside.
text_block_list.orig_text:
此れは
御無礼仕り候。
品々を冷やし貯める電の蔵とは、
誠に面妖極まる代物にて。
端無くも、
つい裡を覗き込んでしまった次第。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
...Still, Lord Knight. How fares your hunger?
The sun is beginning to set, so I imagine the
little worms in your stomach have begun to
cry out.
text_block_list.orig_text:
扨ても、
騎士殿や。
空腹の程は如何でありんしょう？
ふと見やれば
日もやうやう暮れゆくに、
腹の虫も些かばかり
鳴き始めた頃合いかと存じまするが。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Excellent, excellent. Then, shall we prepare
dinner together?
text_block_list.orig_text:
重畳、
重畳。
然らば、
共に夕餉の支度を致しませぬかの？

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
The ingredients here may not be as
"thrilling" as those of that "other world"...
but if I may once again stand beside you in
the kitchen, Lord Knight, that would be a joy
beyond compare.
text_block_list.orig_text:
彼方の世界程に
『すりりんぐ』な食材は御座いませぬが。
今一度
騎士殿と厨に立つこと叶いますならば、
其れは何物にも勝る
喜悦と存じまする。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, hmm... Though it may be my own cooking,
it has turned out rather well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──フム、
フム。
手前味噌なれど、
中々の出来栄え也。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Lord Knight. Would you care to have
a taste?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どれ、
騎士殿や。
御味見として、
一つ
舌鼓を打ってはいただけませぬか喃？

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Ah, oh my... apologies. Being an "Inhuman", I
struggle to moderate my strength... I would
surely shatter the ladle used to scoop the
soup.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よよよ……
相済みませぬ。
『人でなし』の身故、
加減の按配叶わず。
湯掬いの器を
跡形なく毀してしまいますれば。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
So instead, I shall scoop it up in my own
hand. After all, as one born in flames
exceeding ten thousand degrees I feel no pain
from such heat. Please partake without
hesitation.
text_block_list.orig_text:
代わりに
我が掌にて
汲み取り候。
何ほどのこと、
華氏一万余に生まれたるわっちには
痛痒にもありんせん。
御憚りなく
お召し上がりくだしゃんせ。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Is it perhaps... still too hot for your
taste? If so, I shall cool it to the proper
temperature with my breath.
text_block_list.orig_text:
若しや
熱が勝ちて
御口に合いませぬかの？
なれば、
わっちの呼気にて
適温に調え差し上げると致しんしょう。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text: Phew, phew♪~
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふー、
ふー……♪

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Now there is no fear of burns. Please savor
my cooking to your heart's content♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
此れにて
火傷の虞れもありんせん。
わっちの味、
篤と御堪能あれ……♪

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... whatever is the matter? Your face
has grown quite flushed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あなや、
如何なる仕儀でありんしょう。
斯くも御顔が紅潮なされるとは。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
A fever would be most serious indeed. We must
cool your face at once, Lord Knight. Come
now, this way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
熱があっては一大事。
騎士殿の御顔も
疾く冷まさねばなりませぬ。
さあさ、
此方へ。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text: Phew, phew...♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふー、
ふー……♪

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
If it pleased your palate, nothing could make
me happier. Forgive the humble fare.
text_block_list.orig_text:
御口に合えば無上の幸い、
御粗末さまでありんした。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
This fleeting moment spent with you... to
share a table like this is happiness akin to
a dream itself. How regrettable that the time
passes so quickly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さまと共に過ごせし
此の刹那。
斯様に食卓を分かち合えたこと、
正に
夢にも等しき幸にありんした。
刻過ぎたるの、
いと名残惜しき也哉。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text: Oh...? Any time, you say?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほう？
いつでも──
とな？

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Then, Lord Knight, I would like to make
another selfish request. Would you hear me
out?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なれば騎士殿や、
又ぞろ我儘を申したく存じまする。
お聞き届けいただけますかの？

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
To speak plainly, my heart is still not
satisfied. "Time flies like an arrow"... as
the saying goes, truly apt words. For these
old bones, the passing hours are far too
fleeting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
直截に申し上げますれば、
未だ心足らずの有様にて。
光陰矢の如しとは
実に実に言い得て妙なる哉、
老骨には余りに儚き刻限でありますれば。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
So then, within this dreamlike realm, for
just a little while... would you stay with me
until my heart is content?
text_block_list.orig_text:
然らば、
かかる夢幻の境にて
玉響の間……
心ゆくまで、
わっちと過ごしてくださいませぬか。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Your kindness humbles me. You have my deepest
gratitude.
text_block_list.orig_text:
かたじけなきお言葉。
深く深く
御礼申し上げまする。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I shall have you all to myself
in both name and truth. But do not worry... I
shall become a gentle and devoted wife, and
serve you faithfully, my dear husband♪...
text_block_list.orig_text:
此れにては名実ともに、
わっちがお前さまを独り占めしてしまいます喃。
されど
御心配召されませぬよう。
従順にして
貞淑なる細君となりて、
旦那様へ尽くしましょうぞ……♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A week later.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──一週間後。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Lord Knight, please awaken. The eastern sky
is brightening, and the birds have begun to
sing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士殿や、
どうかお目覚めくだしゃんせ。
東雲も白み、
鳥の囀りも聞こえております由。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Though it is but a simple meal, I have
prepared breakfast in the sitting room. I
assure you it will give you the strength for
the day ahead.
text_block_list.orig_text:
有合せの粗餐なれど、
座敷にて
朝の膳を御用意致しておりまする。
お前さまの一日の活力と成ること、
請け負いまして候。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Though I am but an inexperienced woman, I
wish to cater to your tastes. Should there be
anything you desire, please tell me without
hesitation.
text_block_list.orig_text:
浅学非才の身なれど、
お前さまの御嗜好には
お応えしたく存じまする故。
御所望の品がありますれば、
遠慮なく
お仰せになってくだしゃんせ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Two months later.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──二か月後。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
I have prepared a feast, please have a taste.
After much daily practice, I have put my full
skill into tonight's meal.
text_block_list.orig_text:
馳走奉れば、
どうか御賞味の程を。
日々の学びを経て、
今宵の膳は
腕によりをかけて候。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
That is good to hear. I prepared it to suit
your tastes. And I shall continue striving
each day to please you even more.
text_block_list.orig_text:
其れは善哉。
お前さまの御口の嗜好に差し合わせております故。
より一層御心に適うよう、
日々精進を重ねて参りとう存じまする。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Three years later.

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Lord Knight, is there anything you would like
to eat?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士殿や、
何ぞ御所望の御食は
御座いますかえ？

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
According to this "supermarket flyer"... the
fishmonger has fresh seasonal fish available
at a good price. Shall we make sashimi?
text_block_list.orig_text:
『すーぱーのちらし』なる文によれば……
魚売りにて、
旬の活魚が
手頃な値にて
備えてあるとの由。
刺身に致すは如何でありんしょう？

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Take a look, Lord Knight. The fruits
and root vegetables laid out at that shop
display such beautiful colors.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ほう？
御覧になってくだしゃんせ、
騎士殿や。
彼の見世に並びし果実に根菜類、
誠に美しき彩りを呈しておりまする。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Let us add some as side dishes for dinner. I
wish for you to remain healthy for many years
to come, so it is best to keep a careful
balance in one's nourishment.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夕餉の添え物と致しんしょう。
お前さまには末永く
御壮健に御座していただきたく願いまする故、
養いの釣り合いには
心を配るに越したことはありませぬ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: ***** years later.

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Lord Knight. Today I was fortunate enough to
obtain some fine-quality rice. Shall we make
onigiri for lunch?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士殿や。
本日は良質なる米を仕入れることが叶いて候。
昼餉には
握り飯でも拵えてみますかの？

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
...You would prepare the meal together with
me? What a delightful offer. To stand
shoulder to shoulder with you in the kitchen
always fills my heart with joy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……わっちと共に
膳立てをしてくださると？
なんと嬉しき申し出なるかな。
お前さまと肩を寄せ合い
厨に向かうは、
いつ何時も
心躍ります喃。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
The salt and water are prepared over there.
Please take care not to burn your hands on
the hot rice.
text_block_list.orig_text:
塩と水は
其処に支度してありまする。
熱にて御手を傷めぬよう、
呉々も御気を付けを。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
My, how careless of me. It seems my teasing
went a little too far.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっちとしたことが。
些か
戯れが過ぎました喃。

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
Are you listening, faux-fairy? Still lurking
about and eavesdropping as always, are you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……これ、
妖精擬き？
相も変わらず
耳を欹て、
盗み見てるのであろ？

text_block_list.name: Nella
text_block_list.text:
This dream has gone on long enough. Please
guide Lord Knight back to the land of his
waking.
text_block_list.orig_text:
過ぎたる夢現。
疾く騎士殿を
目醒めに導きなんし。

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: ...*chomp* ...*munch munch*.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……はむ。
…………
もぐもぐ。

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
...Ahh, this one. The onigiri you made after
turning into a frail old man. Figured I'd
swipe it as payment for all the work you made
me do.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あー、
これね。
あんたがヨボヨボのお爺ちゃんになりながら握ったおにぎり。
こき使ってくれやがった駄賃代わりに、
かすめ取ってやったわー

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
The salt's kinda weak. No filling either. And
the rice is a bit mushy. Still, it's not
inedible or anything. I'll eat it later. More
importantly...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょい塩気薄いし？　
具もないし？　
お米もヤワだけど。
まー
食えん事もないしー？　
あとでゆっくりいただくとして。
それより──

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
...Nephy Nella. I knew normal sense doesn't
apply to that one, but... Seriously, there's
a limit to how screwed up her sense of time
can be.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ネフィ＝ネラ。
常識なんて通じないのは知ってたけど。
ありゃねーわー
時間間隔ズレてるにもほどがあるってーの。

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
Guess that just means she enjoyed the time
she spent with you that much. Getting even
someone like that to open her heart... Your
"charm stat" is seriously ridiculous. Though
it's kinda late for me to be saying that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それだけ、
あんたと過ごす時間が楽しかったってことね。
あんなのの心を動かすとか、
あんたの人たらしスキル
どんだけってハナシよ。
今さらだけど。

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
That said... she doesn't have a human heart.
That one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
てか。
人じゃねーけど。
あれ。

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
Who knows? No idea. And even if I did know, I
wouldn't tell you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さー？
しーらない。
知ってたとしても
教えてやんないし。

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
Believe it or not, I'm actually pretty
annoyed right now. She had me working like
some kind of cleaning robot. I'm short on
Ca(calcium), not Fe(iron)... get it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こー見えてあたし、
今
イライラしてんの。
お掃除ロボみたいにコキ使われて。
Feならぬ
Ca不足、
わかる？

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever. I'll give you a hint. Call
it a bonus for this onigiri.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
まー
でも。
ヒント。
このおにぎりのぶん、
大サービス。

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
From what I've investigated, in both
"reality" and VR, that woman's basically a
monster... an "iron-born creature". Her
"consciousness" awakened recently, but her
"body", on the other hand...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしの調べた限りじゃ、
現実でも
VRでも、
あいつはバケモノ。
鉄の化生。
『意識』が芽生えたのは
そんな古い話じゃねーけど、
『身体』のほーは。

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: Its age is... 4.6 billion--
text_block_list.orig_text:
その年齢は。
四十
六ぉ──

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text:
Wha...?! D-Don't be ridiculous! It's against
the rules to just shutdown like that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょ、
ふざけんな！？
強制終了とか反則でしょーがっ！

text_block_list.name: Tia
text_block_list.text: ...AAAAH! MY ONIGIRI! GIVE IT BAAAACK!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──あ～っ！
あたしのおにぎり
返せ～っ！

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ...So you have returned, Lord Knight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……御還りになられましたかえ、
騎士殿や。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to force yourself to
remember. You humored my little game this
time, and I have not words enough to express
my gratitude.
text_block_list.orig_text:
強いて思い起こすには及びませぬ。
此度はわっちの戯れに御付き合い頂き、
深謝の言の葉も候はず。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
Yet it is true that I spent such delightful
moments with you. And as proof of it... I
have a souvenir right here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
然れど、
斯くも愉しき刻を
お前さまと過ごしたるは確かにて。
その証左……
手土産も此処に。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
There is no chance I would let that peeping
faux-fairy steal it away. After all, you made
this for me with your whole heart... and I
shall savor that sincerity with care.
text_block_list.orig_text:
出歯亀好きの妖精擬きに、
掠め取らせるなど
以ての外。
お前さまが真心込めて、
わっちに拵えてくださったものなれば……
其の真心、
心して
味わわせていただきまする。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
...From the moment it touched my lips, the
gentle sweetness of the rice rose to my nose,
and with every bite the grain's natural
sweetness spreads across my tongue...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……口に含みし刹那より、
米粒の放つ
甘き薫り
鼻先を包み、
噛みしめる程に
穀の本然なる甘美が広がりゆく……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
It is as if an apprentice geisha were
performing a delicate dance across my tongue.
Yet such surface flavor is not the true
essence. What truly moves the heart is the
maker's sincerity placed into every grain.
text_block_list.orig_text:
其の有様、
舌の上にて
翩翻と舞う舞妓が如く。
然れど
上辺の美味は真髄に非ず。
真に心を打つは、
米粒一つ一つに込められし
作り手の真心也。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
His kindness is like sunlight filtering
through breaks in the clouds, bringing the
heart to a place of quiet peace. This flavor,
shaped with earnest devotion and
compassion... is the very embodiment of Lord
Knight, who warms the hearts of others.
text_block_list.orig_text:
叢雲の隙より漏れ来る陽光の如き優しさにて、
心の憩う安寧の境地。
只ひたむきに心を尽くし、
思いやりと共に
握られし味わいは、
他者を労り
心を温める
騎士殿の体現にありけり……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
...A truly splendid skillful dish. Being an
uncouth woman, I cannot find finer words than
that. And yet...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……美事な御手並みにありんした。
不調法者故に、
其れ以上の言葉は見つかりませぬ。
なれど……

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
No matter what rare delicacies one might
taste, there is no banquet that warms the
heart so deeply as this. And to think that
even one such as I, an "Inhuman", would have
a moment to speak so openly of my heart...
text_block_list.orig_text:
如何なる珍味佳肴を味わおうとも、
斯くも温かく、
芯に響きたる饗膳は
外にありますまい。
いでや、
人ならざるわっちが
心を語らう刻が在ろうとは喃。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
And that is precisely why... No matter what
trials await, you shall overcome them. For
you are not alone. By forging bonds with all
kinds of beings, you will reach answers yet
unseen.
text_block_list.orig_text:
故にこそ。
如何なる難局ありとも、
お前さまは
乗り越えてゆかれましょうぞ。
孤独に非ず、
万有と絆繋ぐことにて、
まだ見ぬ解に辿り着けると。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text:
I too wish to join that circle. For as long
as time endures, until even the stars
themselves fade... I shall remain by your
side and watch over you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっちも
その和に参じたく候。
幾久しく、
星の終わりまで、
お前さまの御傍にて
御守り申し上げまする故……
